tagline: Your local STIHL, Honda, and power equipment partner
heroSubheading: Sales, service, and advice on the brands you trust.
aboutHtml:
We've been supplying and servicing STIHL equipment to the Hawke's Bay community since 1990. Over that time, we've built a reputation for friendly, straightforward advice and work you can trust. Whether you need a chainsaw for the back paddock or a farm bike for getting round the property, we're your local.

We stock STIHL, Honda, Masport, Cub Cadet, and a range of other quality brands. We sell new equipment, service what you've got, sort parts, and answer questions without the waffle. If you need something specific or your existing gear needs attention, we'll look after you.

We're part of this community and we mean it. We sponsor local rugby, golf, dog trialling, and trail bike riding. We support schools and the theatre as well. Come in and see us on the main street, weekdays and Saturday mornings.
whatMakesUsSpecial: Active in local sport and schools
servicesIntro: We service everything we sell and often your existing equipment too.
